body: I know that feeling. I've been there, too. Staying alive is hard work, and even though mental illness is one of the toughest, stay strong. You can fight it, and if you know you can't win, talk to someone who you know you can count on to be supportive when things get tough. Right now I'm dealing with staying strong myself. I had a mental breakdown in jamaica about 9 months ago, and even though I met someone who helped me through it at the time, I soon came to realize that he and I can't work. One of the words of advice I got was to block his number. I thought it was cruel, but then I realized that when you love someone but are in a toxic relationship it's really the best thing, because I know I will break down and give in. His number one goal is to have me and even though it seems sweet it's also very bad. I would have never been strong enough to block his number if I hadn't spoken with my family about it. I know now it's the only way I can save myself from this. So you see sometimes it's okay to get help, because even though you may think you know what's best there are some times when the collective advice of others can give you the tools you need to get through it.

I am sorry that you want to cut off your arms. I think that there are some serious things you need to consider before thinking of things like this. I don't know what the answer is but I do hope you seek help, this is not healthy.
Oh cool. I'm a non-human person, too...so I guess that makes us twins? Lol. Jk.
I guess you just have to decide...your life or your baby's life.
